plugin.name: ExitWindow
plugin.author: ChatGPT
plugin.description:
Displays room exits in a horizontal graphical compass. The title bar shows the current room name and can be dragged. Supports Default (green terminal), Classic, and Amber shared UI themes. The window position is remembered between sessions.
Modular theme client: colours are supplied by UI_Theme_Controller v2.0 when available.

muclient.script:
------------------------------------------------------------ -- WINDOW / FONT IDS ------------------------------------------------------------
local win = "ExitWindow"
local font = "ExitWindowFont" local small_font = "ExitWindowSmallFont"
local label_window = "ExitWindowLabel" local label_font = "ExitWindowLabelFont" local label_image = "ExitWindowLabelImage"
------------------------------------------------------------ -- WINDOW SIZE ------------------------------------------------------------
local MIN_WINDOW_WIDTH = 300 local MIN_WINDOW_HEIGHT = 180 local WINDOW_WIDTH = math.max(MIN_WINDOW_WIDTH, tonumber(GetVariable("exit_width")) or 390) local WINDOW_HEIGHT = math.max(MIN_WINDOW_HEIGHT, tonumber(GetVariable("exit_height")) or 215) local RESIZE_GRIP_SIZE = 14 local resize_active = false
------------------------------------------------------------ -- STATE ------------------------------------------------------------
local exits = {}
local currentRoomName = "EXIT COMPASS"
local window_x = tonumber(GetVariable("window_x")) or 50 local window_y = tonumber(GetVariable("window_y")) or 50
local drag_start_x = 0 local drag_start_y = 0
------------------------------------------------------------ -- SHARED UI THEMES ------------------------------------------------------------
local THEME_CONTROLLER_ID = "43c8d047be7a418ba5e86916"
local THEME_BROADCAST_MESSAGE = 9042
-------------------------------------------------- -- MODULAR THEME CLIENT -- -- The controller owns the real palette. The local THEMES table -- below is retained only as a safe fallback if the controller -- is unavailable. --------------------------------------------------
local THEME_PROFILE = "exit"
function ThemeColour( role, fallback )
local rc, value = CallPlugin( THEME_CONTROLLER_ID, "GetThemeColour", THEME_PROFILE, role )
if rc == error_code.eOK and type( value ) == "string" and value ~= "" then
return ColourNameToRGB( value )
end
return ColourNameToRGB( fallback ) end
local THEMES = {
-------------------------------------------------------- -- CLASSIC -- -- This intentionally preserves the original compass -- colours exactly. --------------------------------------------------------
classic = {
background = "black", panel = "darkslategray", border = "gray",
face = "white", outline = "black", tick = "black", inactive = "black",
dark = "darkgray", gray = "gray", dim = "dimgray", lightgray = "lightgray",
title = "gold",
active = "cyan", active_dark = "darkcyan",
other = "lightgray" },
-------------------------------------------------------- -- AMBER TERMINAL -- -- Near-black brown CRT background, muted amber chrome, -- and brighter phosphor for active information. --------------------------------------------------------
amber = {
background = "#050301", panel = "#160B03", border = "#6B3D18",
face = "#080401", outline = "#A65F20", tick = "#B86A24", inactive = "#080401",
dark = "#6B3D18", gray = "#9A571D", dim = "#5A3213", lightgray = "#D9822B",
title = "#FFB347",
active = "#FF9D26", active_dark = "#7A3D08",
other = "#E38B30" },
-------------------------------------------------------- -- DEFAULT / GREEN TERMINAL -- -- Very dark green CRT background, subdued green grid -- lines, and bright phosphor for active information. --------------------------------------------------------
default = {
background = "#000500", panel = "#061306", border = "#285B28",
face = "#000800", outline = "#3C8A3C", tick = "#4EA34E", inactive = "#000800",
dark = "#245324", gray = "#397A39", dim = "#1C451C", lightgray = "#67C967",
title = "#9AFF82",
active = "#67FF67", active_dark = "#176B24",
other = "#70D970" }
}
------------------------------------------------------------ -- ACTIVE COLOUR PALETTE ------------------------------------------------------------
local C = {}
function LoadTheme()
local theme = GetPluginVariable( THEME_CONTROLLER_ID, "theme" )
if not THEMES[theme] then theme = "default" end
local T = THEMES[theme]
C.background = ThemeColour("background", T.background) C.panel = ThemeColour("panel", T.panel) C.border = ThemeColour("border", T.border)
C.face = ThemeColour("face", T.face) C.outline = ThemeColour("outline", T.outline) C.tick = ThemeColour("tick", T.tick) C.inactive = ThemeColour("inactive", T.inactive)
C.dark = ThemeColour("dark", T.dark) C.gray = ThemeColour("gray", T.gray) C.dim = ThemeColour("dim", T.dim) C.lightgray = ThemeColour("lightgray", T.lightgray)
C.title = ThemeColour("title", T.title)
C.active = ThemeColour("active", T.active) C.active_dark = ThemeColour("active_dark", T.active_dark)
C.other = ThemeColour("other", T.other)
-------------------------------------------------------- -- Compatibility name used elsewhere in the existing -- drawing code and by the rotated-label scratch window. --------------------------------------------------------
C.black = C.background end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- DIRECTIONS ------------------------------------------------------------
local directions = {
{ key="n", label="N", names={ north=true, n=true }, angle=-math.pi/2 },
{ key="ne", label="NE", names={ northeast=true, ne=true }, angle=-math.pi/4 },
{ key="e", label="E", names={ east=true, e=true }, angle=0 },
{ key="se", label="SE", names={ southeast=true, se=true }, angle=math.pi/4 },
{ key="s", label="S", names={ south=true, s=true }, angle=math.pi/2 },
{ key="sw", label="SW", names={ southwest=true, sw=true }, angle=3*math.pi/4 },
{ key="w", label="W", names={ west=true, w=true }, angle=math.pi },
{ key="nw", label="NW", names={ northwest=true, nw=true }, angle=-3*math.pi/4 }
}
------------------------------------------------------------ -- CLICKABLE EXIT HOTSPOTS ------------------------------------------------------------
local exit_hotspots = {}
function ClearExitHotspots() for hotspot_id, _ in pairs(exit_hotspots) do WindowDeleteHotspot(win, hotspot_id) end exit_hotspots = {} end
function ClickExit(flags, hotspot_id) local command = exit_hotspots[hotspot_id] if not command or command == "" then return end Send(command) end
function AddExitHotspot( hotspot_id, left, top, right, bottom, command, tooltip ) exit_hotspots[hotspot_id] = command
WindowAddHotspot( win, hotspot_id, left, top, right, bottom, "", "", "", "", "ClickExit", tooltip or command, miniwin.cursor_hand, 0 ) end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- DIRECTION LOOKUP ------------------------------------------------------------
function FindDirection(exit_name)
exit_name = string.lower(exit_name)
for _, direction in ipairs(directions) do
if direction.names[exit_name] then return direction end
end
return nil end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- SAVE WINDOW POSITION ------------------------------------------------------------
------------------------------------------------------------ -- RESIZING ------------------------------------------------------------
local function SaveWindowSize() SetVariable("exit_width", tostring(math.floor(WINDOW_WIDTH))) SetVariable("exit_height", tostring(math.floor(WINDOW_HEIGHT))) end
function ResizeMouseDown(flags, hotspot_id) resize_active = true; return 0 end
local function UpdateResizeFromMouse() local mouse_x = tonumber(WindowInfo(win, 17)) local mouse_y = tonumber(WindowInfo(win, 18)) local left = tonumber(WindowInfo(win, 10)) or tonumber(WindowInfo(win, 1)) or window_x local top = tonumber(WindowInfo(win, 11)) or tonumber(WindowInfo(win, 2)) or window_y if not mouse_x or not mouse_y then return false end local new_w = math.max(MIN_WINDOW_WIDTH, math.floor(mouse_x - left + 1)) local new_h = math.max(MIN_WINDOW_HEIGHT, math.floor(mouse_y - top + 1)) if new_w == WINDOW_WIDTH and new_h == WINDOW_HEIGHT then return false end WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT = new_w, new_h WindowResize(win, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT, C.background) Redraw() return true end
function ResizeMouseMove(flags, hotspot_id) if resize_active then UpdateResizeFromMouse() end SetCursor(miniwin.cursor_nw_se_arrow) return 0 end
function ResizeMouseUp(flags, hotspot_id) if resize_active then UpdateResizeFromMouse() end resize_active = false SaveWindowSize() WindowMoveHotspot(win,"drag_bar",0,0,WINDOW_WIDTH,30) DrawWindow() return 0 end
local function InstallResizeHandle() WindowDeleteHotspot(win, "00_resize") WindowAddHotspot(win, "00_resize", WINDOW_WIDTH-RESIZE_GRIP_SIZE, WINDOW_HEIGHT-RESIZE_GRIP_SIZE, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT, "", "", "ResizeMouseDown", "", "", "Drag to resize", miniwin.cursor_nw_se_arrow, 0) WindowDragHandler(win, "00_resize", "ResizeMouseMove", "ResizeMouseUp", 0) WindowLine(win, WINDOW_WIDTH-11, WINDOW_HEIGHT-3, WINDOW_WIDTH-3, WINDOW_HEIGHT-11, C.border, miniwin.pen_solid, 1) WindowLine(win, WINDOW_WIDTH-7, WINDOW_HEIGHT-3, WINDOW_WIDTH-3, WINDOW_HEIGHT-7, C.border, miniwin.pen_solid, 1) end
function SaveWindowPosition()
SaveWindowSize()
SetVariable( "window_x", tostring(window_x) )
SetVariable( "window_y", tostring(window_y) )
end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- INSTALL ------------------------------------------------------------
function OnPluginInstall()
LoadTheme()
-------------------------------------------------------- -- Main window --------------------------------------------------------
WindowCreate( win, window_x, window_y, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT, miniwin.pos_top_left, miniwin.create_absolute_location, C.background )
-------------------------------------------------------- -- Fonts --------------------------------------------------------
WindowFont( win, font, "Arial", 11, true, false, false, false )
WindowFont( win, small_font, "Arial", 9, false, false, false, false )
-------------------------------------------------------- -- Temporary miniwindow used for rotated text --------------------------------------------------------
WindowCreate( label_window, 0, 0, 1, 1, miniwin.pos_top_left, miniwin.create_absolute_location, C.black )
WindowFont( label_window, label_font, "Arial", 11, true, false, false, false )
-------------------------------------------------------- -- Drag hotspot --------------------------------------------------------
WindowAddHotspot( win, "drag_bar", 0, 0, WINDOW_WIDTH, 30, "", "", "DragMouseDown", "", "", "Drag window", 0, 0 )
WindowDragHandler( win, "drag_bar", "DragMouseMove", "DragMouseUp", 0 )
-------------------------------------------------------- -- Display --------------------------------------------------------
WindowShow( win, true )
DrawWindow() end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- ENABLE / DISABLE ------------------------------------------------------------
function OnPluginEnable()
LoadTheme()
WindowShow( win, true )
DrawWindow() end
function OnPluginDisable()
SaveWindowPosition()
WindowShow( win, false )
Redraw() end
function OnPluginClose()
SaveWindowPosition()
WindowShow( win, false )
WindowDelete( label_window )
Redraw() end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- DRAGGING ------------------------------------------------------------
function DragMouseDown(flags, hotspot_id)
if hotspot_id ~= "drag_bar" then return end
drag_start_x = WindowInfo(win,14) drag_start_y = WindowInfo(win,15) end
function DragMouseMove(flags, hotspot_id)
local pos_x = WindowInfo(win,17) local pos_y = WindowInfo(win,18)
window_x = pos_x - drag_start_x window_y = pos_y - drag_start_y
WindowPosition( win, window_x, window_y, 0, miniwin.create_absolute_location ) end
function DragMouseUp(flags, hotspot_id)
SaveWindowPosition()
end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- EXIT TRIGGER ------------------------------------------------------------
function OnExits(name, line, wildcards)
exits = {}
currentRoomName = wildcards[1] or "EXIT COMPASS"
local exit_string = wildcards[2] or ""
for exit in string.gmatch( exit_string, "[^,]+" ) do
exit = exit:match( "^%s*(.-)%s*$" )
if exit ~= "" then table.insert( exits, exit ) end
end
DrawWindow() end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- BASIC DRAWING ------------------------------------------------------------
function DrawCircle(x,y,radius,outline,fill,width)
WindowCircleOp( win, miniwin.circle_ellipse, x-radius, y-radius, x+radius, y+radius, outline, miniwin.pen_solid, width or 1, fill, miniwin.brush_solid, 0, 0, 0, 0 ) end
function DrawLine(x1,y1,x2,y2,colour,width)
WindowLine( win, x1, y1, x2, y2, colour, miniwin.pen_solid, width or 1 ) end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- RESPONSIVE COMPASS GEOMETRY ------------------------------------------------------------
function CurrentCompassRadius() local dividerX = math.max(150, math.floor(WINDOW_WIDTH * 0.51)) local bodyH = WINDOW_HEIGHT - 30 return math.max(42, math.min(86, math.floor(math.min(dividerX - 26, bodyH - 26) / 2))) end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- DIRECTION ARROWS ------------------------------------------------------------
function DrawDirectionArrow(cx,cy,angle,active)
local compass_radius = CurrentCompassRadius() local inner_radius = math.max(9, math.floor(compass_radius * 0.19)) local outer_radius = math.max(inner_radius + 18, math.floor(compass_radius * 0.73))
local x1 = cx + math.cos(angle) * inner_radius
local y1 = cy + math.sin(angle) * inner_radius
local x2 = cx + math.cos(angle) * outer_radius
local y2 = cy + math.sin(angle) * outer_radius
if active then
DrawLine( x1, y1, x2, y2, C.active_dark, 7 )
DrawLine( x1, y1, x2, y2, C.active, 3 )
local head_length = math.max(8, math.floor(compass_radius * 0.19)) local head_width = math.max(5, math.floor(compass_radius * 0.10))
local hx = x2 - math.cos(angle) * head_length
local hy = y2 - math.sin(angle) * head_length
local px = -math.sin(angle)
local py = math.cos(angle)
local left_x = hx + px * head_width
local left_y = hy + py * head_width
local right_x = hx - px * head_width
local right_y = hy - py * head_width
WindowPolygon( win,
string.format( "%d,%d,%d,%d,%d,%d",
math.floor(x2), math.floor(y2),
math.floor(left_x), math.floor(left_y),
math.floor(right_x), math.floor(right_y) ),
C.active_dark, miniwin.pen_solid, 1,
C.active, miniwin.brush_solid,
true, false )
else
DrawLine( x1, y1, x2, y2, C.dim, 1 )
end end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- COMPASS TICKS ------------------------------------------------------------
function DrawCompassTicks(cx,cy)
local compass_radius = CurrentCompassRadius() local outer = math.max(30, compass_radius - 5) local inner_minor = math.max(26, outer - math.max(4, math.floor(compass_radius * 0.07))) local inner_major = math.max(23, outer - math.max(8, math.floor(compass_radius * 0.14)))
for i=0,71 do
local angle = i * ( math.pi * 2 / 72 )
local length
if i % 9 == 0 then
length = inner_major
elseif i % 3 == 0 then
length = inner_minor + 2
else
length = inner_minor
end
local x1 = cx + math.cos(angle) * outer
local y1 = cy + math.sin(angle) * outer
local x2 = cx + math.cos(angle) * length
local y2 = cy + math.sin(angle) * length
local width = 1
if i % 9 == 0 then width = 2 end
DrawLine( x1, y1, x2, y2, C.tick, width )
end end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- ROTATED LABEL ------------------------------------------------------------
function DrawRotatedLabel( text, destination_x, destination_y, rotation, colour )
local text_width = WindowTextWidth( label_window, label_font, text, false )
local text_height = WindowFontInfo( label_window, label_font, 1 )
local padding_x = 3 local padding_y = 2
local image_width = text_width + padding_x * 2
local image_height = text_height + padding_y * 2
WindowDelete( label_window )
WindowCreate( label_window, 0, 0, image_width, image_height, miniwin.pos_top_left, miniwin.create_absolute_location, C.black )
WindowFont( label_window, label_font, "Arial", 11, true, false, false, false )
WindowText( label_window, label_font, text,
padding_x, padding_y,
image_width, image_height,
colour, false )
WindowImageFromWindow( win, label_image, label_window )
local radians = math.rad( rotation )
local cosine = math.cos( radians )
local sine = math.sin( radians )
local mxx = cosine local mxy = -sine
local myx = sine local myy = cosine
local source_cx = image_width / 2
local source_cy = image_height / 2
local left = destination_x - ( source_cx * mxx + source_cy * mxy )
local top = destination_y - ( source_cx * myx + source_cy * myy )
WindowTransformImage( win, label_image,
math.floor( left + 0.5 ),
math.floor( top + 0.5 ),
miniwin.image_transparent_copy,
mxx, mxy, myx, myy ) end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- CARDINAL LABEL ------------------------------------------------------------
function DrawCardinalLabel( text, centre_x, centre_y, colour )
local text_width = WindowTextWidth( win, font, text, false )
local text_height = WindowFontInfo( win, font, 1 )
local left = centre_x - text_width / 2
local top = centre_y - text_height / 2
WindowText( win, font, text,
math.floor( left + 0.5 ),
math.floor( top + 0.5 ),
0, 0,
colour, false ) end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- DIRECTION LABELS ------------------------------------------------------------
function DrawDirectionLabels(cx,cy,active)
local compassRadius = CurrentCompassRadius() local cardinal_radius = compassRadius + 12 local diagonal_radius = compassRadius + 11
for _,direction in ipairs(directions) do
local colour = C.inactive
if active[direction.key] then colour = C.active end
if direction.key == "n" then
DrawCardinalLabel( "N", cx, cy - cardinal_radius, colour )
elseif direction.key == "e" then
DrawCardinalLabel( "E", cx + cardinal_radius, cy, colour )
elseif direction.key == "s" then
DrawCardinalLabel( "S", cx, cy + cardinal_radius, colour )
elseif direction.key == "w" then
DrawCardinalLabel( "W", cx - cardinal_radius, cy, colour )
elseif direction.key == "ne" then
local x = cx + math.cos( direction.angle ) * diagonal_radius
local y = cy + math.sin( direction.angle ) * diagonal_radius
DrawRotatedLabel( "NE", x, y, 45, colour )
elseif direction.key == "se" then
local x = cx + math.cos( direction.angle ) * diagonal_radius
local y = cy + math.sin( direction.angle ) * diagonal_radius
DrawRotatedLabel( "SE", x, y, -45, colour )
elseif direction.key == "sw" then
local x = cx + math.cos( direction.angle ) * diagonal_radius
local y = cy + math.sin( direction.angle ) * diagonal_radius
DrawRotatedLabel( "SW", x, y, 45, colour )
elseif direction.key == "nw" then
local x = cx + math.cos( direction.angle ) * diagonal_radius
local y = cy + math.sin( direction.angle ) * diagonal_radius
DrawRotatedLabel( "NW", x, y, -45, colour )
end
end end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- DRAW COMPASS ------------------------------------------------------------
function DrawCompass()
local dividerX = math.max(150, math.floor(WINDOW_WIDTH * 0.51)) local bodyH = WINDOW_HEIGHT - 30 local cx = math.floor(dividerX / 2) local cy = 30 + math.floor(bodyH / 2)
local outer_radius = CurrentCompassRadius() local face_radius = outer_radius - 4
local active = {}
for _,exit in ipairs(exits) do
local direction = FindDirection( exit )
if direction then
active[ direction.key ] = true
end
end
DrawCircle( cx, cy, outer_radius + 2, C.outline, C.outline, 2 )
DrawCircle( cx, cy, outer_radius, C.dark, C.face, 1 )
DrawCircle( cx, cy, face_radius, C.outline, C.face, 1 )
DrawCompassTicks( cx, cy )
for _,direction in ipairs(directions) do
DrawDirectionArrow( cx, cy, direction.angle, active[ direction.key ] == true )
end
DrawDirectionLabels( cx, cy, active )
DrawCircle( cx, cy, 11, C.outline, C.face, 2 )
DrawCircle( cx, cy, 4, C.active_dark, C.active, 1 )
-------------------------------------------------------- -- Clickable active compass directions. --------------------------------------------------------
local hotspot_radius = math.max(34, outer_radius - 13) local hotspot_half = math.max(11, math.floor(outer_radius * 0.21))
for _, direction in ipairs(directions) do if active[direction.key] then local hx = cx + math.cos(direction.angle) * hotspot_radius
local hy = cy + math.sin(direction.angle) * hotspot_radius
AddExitHotspot( "compass_exit_" .. direction.key, math.floor(hx - hotspot_half), math.floor(hy - hotspot_half), math.floor(hx + hotspot_half), math.floor(hy + hotspot_half), direction.key, "Go " .. direction.label ) end end end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- OTHER EXITS ------------------------------------------------------------
function DrawOtherExits()
local other_exits = {}
for _,exit in ipairs(exits) do
if not FindDirection(exit) then
table.insert( other_exits, exit )
end
end
WindowText( win, font, "OTHER EXITS",
math.max(160, math.floor(WINDOW_WIDTH * 0.51)) + 13, 43,
WINDOW_WIDTH - 15, 59,
C.title, false )
WindowLine( win,
math.max(160, math.floor(WINDOW_WIDTH * 0.51)) + 13, 62,
WINDOW_WIDTH - 15, 62,
C.dim, miniwin.pen_solid, 1 )
if #other_exits == 0 then
WindowText( win, small_font, "None",
math.max(160, math.floor(WINDOW_WIDTH * 0.51)) + 18, 71,
WINDOW_WIDTH - 15, 88,
C.dim, false )
return end
local y = 70
for index,exit in ipairs(other_exits) do
DrawCircle( math.max(160, math.floor(WINDOW_WIDTH * 0.51)) + 19, y + 6, 3, C.active_dark, C.active, 1 )
WindowText( win, small_font, exit,
math.max(160, math.floor(WINDOW_WIDTH * 0.51)) + 29, y,
WINDOW_WIDTH - 15, y + 17,
C.other, false )
---------------------------------------------------- -- Entire other-exit row is clickable. ----------------------------------------------------
AddExitHotspot( "other_exit_" .. tostring(index), math.max(160, math.floor(WINDOW_WIDTH * 0.51)) + 9, y - 2, WINDOW_WIDTH - 10, y + 17, exit, "Go: " .. exit )
y = y + 19
if y > WINDOW_HEIGHT - 20 then break end
end end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- DRAW MAIN WINDOW ------------------------------------------------------------
function DrawWindow()
-------------------------------------------------------- -- Rebuild dynamic exit hotspots every redraw so room -- changes cannot leave stale clickable exits behind. --------------------------------------------------------
ClearExitHotspots()
WindowRectOp( win, miniwin.rect_fill, 0, 0, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT, C.background )
WindowRectOp( win, miniwin.rect_fill, 0, 0, WINDOW_WIDTH, 30, C.panel )
WindowLine( win,
0, 29,
WINDOW_WIDTH, 29,
C.border, miniwin.pen_solid, 1 )
local title_width = WindowTextWidth( win, font, currentRoomName, false )
local title_x = math.floor( ( WINDOW_WIDTH - title_width ) / 2 )
WindowText( win, font, currentRoomName,
title_x, 6,
WINDOW_WIDTH - 10, 24,
C.title, false )
WindowLine( win,
math.floor(WINDOW_WIDTH * 0.51), 36,
math.floor(WINDOW_WIDTH * 0.51), WINDOW_HEIGHT - 10,
C.dim, miniwin.pen_solid, 1 )
DrawCompass()
DrawOtherExits()
WindowRectOp( win, miniwin.rect_frame, 0, 0, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT, C.border )
WindowShow( win, true )
InstallResizeHandle() Redraw() end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- THEME BROADCAST ------------------------------------------------------------
function OnPluginBroadcast( msg, id, name, text )
if msg ~= THEME_BROADCAST_MESSAGE then return end
if id ~= THEME_CONTROLLER_ID then return end
LoadTheme()
-------------------------------------------------------- -- Recreate the rotated-label scratch window with the -- new terminal background colour. --------------------------------------------------------
WindowDelete( label_window )
WindowCreate( label_window, 0, 0, 1, 1, miniwin.pos_top_left, miniwin.create_absolute_location, C.background )
WindowFont( label_window, label_font, "Arial", 11, true, false, false, false )
DrawWindow() end
-------------------------------------------------- -- PLUGIN CONTROLLER LAYOUT API --------------------------------------------------
function ManagedLayoutParse(spec) local windowName, sx, sy, sw, sh = tostring(spec or ""):match("^([^\t]+)\t(-?%d+)\t(-?%d+)\t(%d+)\t(%d+)$") if not windowName then return nil end return windowName, tonumber(sx), tonumber(sy), tonumber(sw), tonumber(sh) end
function GetManagedLayoutWindows() -- Deliberately excludes ExitWindowLabel, which is only an off-screen scratch -- surface used to rotate text. return win end
function ApplyManagedLayout(spec) local windowName, x, y, w, h = ManagedLayoutParse(spec) if windowName ~= win then return "wrong window" end
window_x = math.floor(x) window_y = math.floor(y) WINDOW_WIDTH = math.max(MIN_WINDOW_WIDTH, math.floor(w)) WINDOW_HEIGHT = math.max(MIN_WINDOW_HEIGHT, math.floor(h))
WindowResize( win, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT, C.background )
SaveWindowPosition() DrawWindow() WindowPosition(win, window_x, window_y, miniwin.pos_top_left, miniwin.create_absolute_location) pcall(SaveState) Redraw() return "ok" end
